sayIt.cover: Read the three facts out loud, slowly: when it started, when it renews, what it renews at. Then: 'Since we're on the call, I can do one thing for you.' Click.
sayIt.offer: Lead with the name and the one-liner. Read the stack top to bottom, then the bonuses one click at a time. Land on the price and stop talking.
sayIt.pay: 'I have your card on file. Do I have your permission to run it?' Then silence. If they hesitate: Objections tab, press /.
sayIt.gameplan: Get a yes on each line, one at a time. Wait for the yes before the next one.
sayIt.review: Show the code and wait until it's posted. Then: 'Post that script in the next 24 hours and text me the link.'
